# Getting help

Thank you for using `{odsql}`!

- If you have a GitHub account, please
[file an issue](https://github.com/patterninstitute/odsql/issues/new)
with your question or bug report.

- If you do not have a GitHub account, you can contact either Ramiro Magno
<rmagno@pattern.institute> or Lucas Bicalho <lucas.sb567@gmail.com>.

- If your question pertains more directly to Opendatasoft's Explore API,
please reach out to them at <support@opendatasoft.com>.
